title.orig: Se una notte d’inverno un viaggiatore
title.en: If on a Winter’s Night a Traveller

review.en: You, the reader, start a novel by Calvino, find it misbound, and chase its continuation through ten openings of ten different books that never go on. It is a game about reading itself, elegant and full of wit, with a love story running through it. The trick is brilliant; the cleverness can keep feeling at arm’s length.
review.zh: 你，读者，开始读一本卡尔维诺的新小说，发现装订出错，于是追着去找下文，却遇到十本不同小说的十个开头，没有一本续下去。这是一场关于阅读本身的游戏，优雅机智，中间贯穿着一段爱情。构思精彩，只是机巧有时让情感隔着一层。
